schemaNote: Ledger of citations backing every token and asset-role decision. `source` is "path:startLine-endLine" relative to the source project (NOT shipped in this package; extraction/verify_all.py resolves source-tree citations only when the sibling tree is present and otherwise prints a warning). public/styles/coda-main.css is minified onto ONE line, so its citations are always 1-1 and carry a `charRange` (0-based character offsets) that locates the quoted text. Later build passes appended to `citations`; ids are unique.
sourceRootNote: Paths are relative to the cloned project root that contains src/, public/, index.html and CLONE_SPEC.md.

copyEvidence.a-exact: Homepage copy is exact, taken from the user's own saved page. Structure, layout and motion were measured against the live site (~1px).
copyEvidence.b-real-saved-copy: Five inner pages (coda-links, coda-giftcloud, distribution, consumer-platforms, pricing) carry real text from the user's own saved copies. Structure/layout/motion measured against live.
copyEvidence.c-original-slot-sized: Nine pages (codapay, coda-webstore, six industries, merchant-of-record) carry ORIGINAL newly written copy sized to the original slot lengths - NOT Coda's wording. Structure/layout/motion measured against live (~1px) but copy budgets derive from slot lengths, not measured real copy.
copyEvidence.rule: Record per route and per template; never flatten. Contracts/examples use only short original headings, labels and CTAs within maxWords; never paste paragraphs from pages or saved HTML.

citation.declaration: Quoted directly from a CSS/JSX/JS declaration or attribute at the cited location.
citation.counted: A count derived by a histogram script over src/**/*.jsx|js (class-name tokens, regex counted); the cited line is one representative occurrence, the count is in the claim/token usage field.
citation.spec-measured: A value measured on the live site or read from the bundle and recorded in CLONE_SPEC.md; the cited line is that record.
citation.inferred: An absence claim or reading inferred from the evidence (e.g. no dark theme, no reduced-motion handling); the note says how it was verified.

perRouteCopyEvidence._note: Copy evidence level per route (a-exact / b-real-saved-copy / c-original-slot-sized). Level c budgets derive from slot lengths, not from measured real copy. Structure evidence for the 14 inner pages is carried over from section contracts (see cit-p3-structure-caveat).
